random_control: Per physical query/reference key, RNG seed20261016+CRC32(canonicalJSON[pair,query,reference]); uniformly permute distinct local tokens onbothsides, min(M,N) one-to-one random cosine times mincoverage. Never GTseed. Record random identityranking on exactsamecandidates; singleton unavailable.
ties: Exact equal visual candidate scores break using original native fulltrackrank; identical for allbackbones. No tolerance tuned on results.
denominators: MNN coverage divides by selectedunique tokens<=16; additionally report observed mutual/all realavailable regionpatches. These fractions do not imply exhaustive matching of unselectedpatches. ROIinterpolation never counted as realpoints.
